pr.title: feat(checkout): pass the rounding config to LineItemQuantitySplitter::split()
pr.body: Split line item taxes are rounded with an explicit rounding config in 6.8. `split()` gets a fourth argument, announced with `#[NewRequiredParameter]`; calls without it trigger a deprecation warning until 6.8. Core callers pass the argument. RELEASE_INFO and UPGRADE entries are included. We checked how store plugins use `split()` before the change.
pr.author: synthetic
